task_intent: Support LDAP StartTLS authorization when authorization searches use the configured system account.
intent_source: INTRO commit message, LdapRealm change, and tightened existing StartTLS integration test
evaluator_plan: Run a fixed external Bolt login/authorization scenario against an LDAP server requiring confidentiality, with StartTLS and system-account authorization enabled, and assert a valid reader can authenticate and authorize.

evidence: INTRO subject precisely states StartTLS support for authorization using system account
1b74de13 obtains the authorization system context without StartTLS even when StartTLS is configured
26ff65cc adds getSystemLdapContextUsingStartTls and selects it for system-account authorization
46de5d01 adds an authentication-triggering lookup but retains StartTLS system-account authorization
The Bolt/LDAP scenario observes login and authorization behavior rather than code identity
The valid-password success scenario does not require the later wrong-password rejection fix
Task and environment are directly stated by INTRO and its modified historical integration test
26ff65cc generalizes getLdapContextUsingStartTls and reuses it for both user authentication and system context; 46de5d01 later forces lookup to verify credentials
